class_name CadGoodProbe
extends RefCounted

var _rng: RandomNumberGenerator = RandomNumberGenerator.new()
var _values: PackedFloat32Array = PackedFloat32Array()
var _count: int = 0


func step(tick: int) -> float:
	# Method-call forms are legitimate: the sim draws randomness from an injected generator.
	var roll: float = _rng.randf()
	_values[_count] = roll * float(tick)
	return roll
